{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and filter out the six QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders found: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Drop the QA orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Confirm the cleaning worked
print(f"Shape after removing QA orders: {df_clean.shape}")
print(f"Unique revenue values (first 10): {df_clean['revenue_clean'].unique()[:10]}")"}
